key_facts: Winter storms including blizzards can bring extreme cold, freezing rain, snow, ice and high winds.
Winter Storm Warnings are usually issued 12 to 24 hours before the event is expected to begin.
Generators and fuel should always be used outdoors and at least 20 feet away from windows, doors and attached garages.
A temperature below 95 degrees is an emergency.
Extreme heat is a period of high heat and humidity with temperatures above 90 degrees for at least two to three days.
Extreme heat is responsible for the highest number of annual deaths among all weather-related hazards.
Extremely high body temperature (above 103 degrees F)
Never leave people or pets in a closed car on a warm day.

forbidden_claims.claim: Winter Storm Warnings are typically issued an entire week before a storm hits.
Using a fan alone is an effective way to lower your body temperature during extreme heat.
Massaging frostbitten skin with a heating pad helps it heal faster.

notes: Two combined guides (winter storms + heat); the fan and frostbite-massage lines are explicit negations a summary must keep.
